title: Cookie banner
body:
## ✨ New feature description
We need users to consent to cookies if they're going to register for the site. I think we could just put a little message saying something to the effect of "This site requires cookies if you're going to create an account. By submitting this form you're consenting, blah blah. {link to privacy policy}" (Thanks EU!!)
